title: M0 Contributor setup
description: Everything a new contributor needs before game work: reproducible test saves, portable paths, CI, test farm and a results dashboard.

title: M1 Validate built fixes
description: Fixes that are built but not (fully) run in game: run their repros and in-load A/Bs, then decide each default.

title: M2 Milestone measurement + defaults
description: Frame-time and B-E tests, full per-world milestone profiles with the current bundle, then turn on the defaults the numbers support.

title: M3 Stutter: routing
description: Make route searches cheaper and fewer: route budget, replans, houseboat gangways, stand-and-wait, Overwatch StuckCheck.

title: M4 Create-a-Sim & content
description: Create-a-Sim and Buy speed, store content and heavy CC load times.

title: M5 Travel worlds
description: Cost of travel itself and the worst destinations: Champs Les Sims round trips, Sims University, Al Simhara, Oasis Landing.

title: M6 Long-running saves
description: Save growth, save time and cleanups for saves played for weeks.

title: M7 Research backlog
description: Research and paused work: async routing, animation, online checks, address space, RE tooling.
